What changed in this PR Removes the deprecated `ProcessResource` accessor while preserving factory methods and their privacy-safe defaults. **Changes:** - Removes `get()` and its eagerly initialized singleton. - Clarifies command-attribute behavior and tests explicit opt-out. - Documents the API migration. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/​resources/​library/​src/​test/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​resources/​ProcessResourceTest.java | Tests `create(false)` privacy behavior. | | instrumentation/​resources/​library/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​resources/​ProcessResource.java | Removes deprecated accessor and clarifies factory documentation. | | CHANGELOG.md | Records removal and replacement factories. |
Review effort: Balanced

[General] Move this entry to `⚠️ Breaking changes to non-stable APIs` at CHANGELOG.md:294. `ProcessResource` belongs to the alpha resources library, so placing its removal under general breaking changes obscures the stable/non-stable API distinction required by `.github/copilot-instructions.md:35–36`. Keep the migration guidance when moving it.

Remove `ProcessResource.get()` and its eagerly initialized singleton while preserving the supported factories and their privacy behavior.

- **API:** Document that `create()` omits command-line attributes; `create(boolean)` includes them only when explicitly enabled. Add coverage for `create(false)` and record the breaking-change migration.
- **Migration:**
  ```java
  // Before
  Resource resource = ProcessResource.get();

  // Privacy-safe default
  Resource resource = ProcessResource.create();

  // Only when command attributes are intended
  Resource resource = ProcessResource.create(true);
  ```
metadata.title: Remove deprecated ProcessResource accessor
